More bug squashing in #OpenCrystalCaves, plus an episode chooser!

Original #DOS #CrystalCaves came with 3 episodes but each one was its own .exe. OTOH Crystal Caves HD lets you pick the episode when starting a new game. For OCC we’ve replaced the “Ordering Info” menu option with “Choose Episode” when a registered version is detected, which reloads all the data files in-place (notice the subtly different BG art). Clever / works well? Maybe!
